issues.description: Constructor parameter mismatch for the Animal subclasses (Seal, Pig, Goat): the template repository's example usages in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java show two-argument instantiations (e.g., Seal("Clarabelle", "marine"), Pig("Doodle", "domestic"), Goat("Buttinsky", "mountain")). The problem statement UML and the reference solution define Animal subclasses with a single 'name' attribute and single-argument constructors (e.g., Seal(String name), Pig(String name), Goat(String name)). This inconsistency between the example in the template Main and the UML/specification + solution can mislead students about the required constructor signatures and which attributes must be initialized.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor usage consistent across artifacts. Recommended: update the commented example instantiations in template src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to use the single-argument constructors that match the UML and solution (e.g., Seal("Clarabelle"), Pig("Doodle"), Goat("Buttinsky")). Alternatively, if a second 'species' attribute is intended pedagogically, update the UML/problem statement and the solution classes to include that attribute and corresponding two-argument constructors, and adjust the examples accordingly.
